target: doses delivered (service volume), not latent demand
limitations: The backtest refits each method at 7 monthly origins and scores 30 forecasts of up to 6 months ahead across 9 complete synthetic months. The same backtest selected the model, so its reported error may be optimistic. Independent future validation is still needed. The band is a descriptive range from errors up to 6 months ahead; 12-month-ahead errors are likely larger, and it is not a calibrated prediction interval. 3 missing or invalid facility-months are filled from the prior year for fitting only. Delivered doses may understate true demand.
